card.name: Linking words in clinical study descriptions
card.fires_on: Small linking or verb words right after phrases like 'in clinical trials', 'in patients who' or 'in an open-label study', just before the study drug or population is named. Also the ending of 'rechallenged'.

modes.label: Study-setting links
modes.description: The word 'of' or 'with' after 'In clinical trials/studies', leading into the drug or patient group.
modes.example: In clinical trials<< of>> patients with pancreatic adenocarcinoma

modes.label: Verb after a patient or subject
modes.description: A participle such as 'treated', 'received' or 'been' that comes before the drug name.
modes.example: In patients who<< received>> SARCLISA ESCENA subcutaneously

modes.label: Open-label study wording
modes.example: 5.3 QT Prolongation In an<< open>>-label QTc study in patients with schizophrenia

card.writes: The promoted tokens are words about the future, which does not fit the text well, so there is no clear output effect.
card.plain: It fires on the small connecting word in sentences that open a description of what happened in a clinical study.
